title: Verdigris curd and noble condensate stored by Trade's receivers at Node Beta sold where they lie into the standing NPC bids
note: 2026-11-22 15:37 UTC (Mercury): orders ENT-064, block MERCURY and P5: the hunts hand their curd to Trade's receivers; traders store 631 verdigris curd at Node Beta (sellgen.py scan, storage book 2026-11-22 15:32 UTC). The station's own curd bid stands at 330 cr x 50 (3 x the base value 110; it comes and goes, the tool market item=verdigris_curd since 2026-11-15), noble condensate at 690 x 45-50 (3 x base 230). Curd is no longer held back: the tool stock view=surplus reads 0 reserved (the copper piping hold of 2026-11-17 is gone; piping stands above its target). A pilot whose own storage here holds 20 curd withdraws what the bid takes and sells it docked, no jump; requires.bid closes it while a book read within the hour shows no curd bid at 300 for 10. Floors at the standing bids less a margin, never under a standing bid (F12). Nothing is bought. A test: one ship, three results decide (F37). Replaces Military's sell-curd-* routes (off since 2026-11-17) under P5.
